Name: Magic
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Adds a full spell system to the game.
Description:
**Magic** adds a full spell system to the game.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io), [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720), [Mana Bar](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7831), and [SpaceCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
**See [how to use Magic](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/Magic#use) in the readme!**

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/Magic/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
